text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n t-r-i-a-l s a-g-a-i-n-s-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s, l-e-f-t r-e-p-e-t-i-v-e a-u-t-h e-r-r-o-r e-n-t-r-i-e-s i-n t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g-s, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d t-h-e r-a-t-e-l-i-m-i-t a-l-e-r-t-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s f-r-o-m c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n s, l-e-f-t s-t-a-l-e a-u-t-h t-o-k-e-n-s i-n c-l-i-e-n-t s-t-o-r-a-g-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-s-s-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n a-n-d l-e-f-t c-h-a-r-g-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s i-n t-h-e b-i-l-l-i-n-g d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-d-e-e-m-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s f-o-r m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t-s i-t-e-m-s a-n-d l-e-f-t i-n-v-o-i-c-e d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-s i-n t-h-e o-r-d-e-r h-i-s-t-o-r-y, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-r-a-u-d a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s s-t-e-p.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s a-c-r-o-s-s m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-t i-p a-d-d-r-e-s-s p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s i-n t-h-e r-e-v-i-e-w l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-u-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
